description.text:
Hawes & Curtis is a quintessentially British brand specialising in luxury shirts, fine tailoring, casualwear and accessories for men and women. Since Hawes & Curtis was founded in 1913 by Ralph Hawes and George Frederick Curtis, it has become the go-to brand for British classics.

Specialising in formalwear for more than a century, Hawes & Curtis’ superior tailoring has been a favourite among royalty and Hollywood luminaries. Hawes & Curtis continues to represent the best of British to this day, and is proud to be the official tailor to Northampton Saints Rugby Club, one of the world’s best-known and best-loved rugby clubs.

Simply put, Hawes & Curtis offers innovative design, exceptional quality and outstanding value.

Location: Canada Place
